meta.title: Gold engagement rings, verified line by line
meta.subtitle: 25 listings from 13 sellers · 18 rows re-read live on 2026-10-23, the 7 Etsy rows carry their 2026-10-22 capture date and say so · every value tied to the source page that states it · blanks are flagged, never guessed
meta.noHallucinations: NO HALLUCINATIONS IS THE RULE OF THIS PROJECT. Every price, karat, weight, policy and claim on this site was read from the linked official source page on the date shown next to it. If a value could not be confirmed, it is left BLANK and published on the Flagged for Review page — never inferred, estimated or filled in from a similar listing. Derived numbers (fine-gold grams, metal value, price/metal) are computed from verified inputs and recomputed by the checker. After every review pass, run python3 scripts/verify.py.

flags.title: Price is BELOW the computed gold metal value
flags.detail: A 7 g 14K band listed at $444.80 contains about 4.08 g of fine gold. At the verified spot price the metal alone is worth about $529 — more than the asking price. For a legitimate seller that is not economic, and it is the classic fraud signal. The listing is sold, so it is kept only as a case study. Do not treat any below-metal price as a bargain.

flags.title: Listing photos solicit off-platform contact
flags.detail: VeraByEden listing image 11 is a chat screenshot showing an address (2355 Westwood Boulevard #153, Los Angeles CA) and the text 'Share your contact information with us on Etsy Message.' Off-platform payment or contact can void Etsy Purchase Protection. Keep any purchase on Etsy and pay through Etsy checkout.

flags.title: Gram weight is not published (17 of 25 rows)
flags.detail: Without a weight you cannot compute gold content or compare price with metal value. These cells are left blank — never estimated. Ask the seller in writing for the weight in grams before buying, then verify it on arrival.

flags.title: Independent seller reputation not captured for most sellers
flags.detail: Only Blue Nile has independent complaint data captured (BBB and ConsumerAffairs). Brilliant Earth shows on-site review scores; Allurez, Avianne, Jewelry Master, Solid Gold Jewelers and the Etsy shops have no independent complaint data in this dataset. Do the check yourself: search the business name plus 'complaint' or 'review', confirm a real phone/address, and look for a BBB profile.

flags.title: Blue Nile: resized, engraved and custom rings are not returnable
flags.detail: Blue Nile's 30-day money-back guarantee excludes personalized jewelry, custom orders, engraved items, items resized after purchase, Diamond Upgrade purchases, clearance and Final Sale. Returns are capped at two complimentary returns per customer per year, an RMA is required, and a missing diamond grading report costs $150. Do not resize before deciding to keep the ring.

flags.title: Blue Nile lifetime warranty starts at $1,000; some settings fall below it
flags.detail: The limited lifetime warranty covers gold and platinum items with a purchase price of $1,000 or more. Of the Blue Nile settings recorded here, the $870 Classic Four Prong falls below that threshold (the $1,000 Petite Solitaire sits exactly at it), so it does not qualify for the lifetime warranty under the stated terms.

flags.title: Resolved in pass 3: Brilliant Earth return policy verified (30-day window, exclusions published)
flags.detail: Verified live 2026-10-23 at https://www.brilliantearth.com/30-Day-Returns/ (page title: 'Brilliant Earth Returns & Exchanges | 30 Day Return Policy | Free Return Shipping'): returns within 30 days of receipt, unworn and in original condition; engraved items ($40 fee), personalized, custom, altered, resized or modified items and repairs are excluded. The previously linked brilliantearth.com/customer-care/return-policy/ redirects to the home page and brilliantearth.com/returns/ returns 404 — all four Brilliant Earth entries now link the working policy URL.

flags.title: Brilliant Earth: USD price not confirmable — product pages serve EUR (geo-currency)
flags.detail: On 2026-10-23 both the BE-1343HH and BE-SECRET product pages served EUR instead of USD (€1,350.00 and €1,250.00, Setting Only) because of geo-currency. Prior USD captures are kept only as dated observations in the price notes: $1,190 (BE-1343HH product page, 2026-10-22) and $1,090 (BE-SECRET via the yellow-gold category listing, 2026-10-22). The price cells are BLANK — no conversion, no guess — until a USD price is re-confirmable (for example from a US checkout).

flags.title: Allurez shows an 'Everyone Else' comparison price — not used
flags.detail: Allurez pages display a '% Savings' figure against an 'Everyone Else' price ($2,497 / $1,373 / $1,194 on the three rings here). That comparison is the seller's own marketing claim and is not independently verified. Only the actual selling price is used in this project.

flags.title: Allurez: Design Your Own rings are exchange-only
flags.detail: Allurez's policy says Design Your Own engagement rings may be exchanged for items of the same or higher value but cannot be refunded. It does not say whether buying a setting on its own counts as 'Design Your Own'. Treat these settings as possibly exchange-only and confirm in writing before buying.

flags.title: Avianne: 14-day window, active promo code, full policy not captured
flags.detail: The product page says returns of unworn and unaltered items are accepted within 14 days — shorter than the 30 days common elsewhere. The site also runs a 10% code (FALL10), which is not applied to the recorded price. The full return policy and resize exclusions were not captured.

flags.title: Jewelry Master: 'Retail Price' is a seller comparison; guarantee restrictions unspecified
flags.detail: The page shows a Retail Price of $6,041 against a Special Price of $3,020. The retail figure is the seller's own comparison and is not used in any analysis. The 30-day money-back guarantee says 'some restrictions apply' but does not list them.

flags.title: Solid Gold Jewelers: no price and no return policy published
flags.detail: The product page states '14ky, 4.7g, #B02561' and asks buyers to call (309) 452-1612 for current pricing and availability. No price and no return policy appear on the page, so both are left blank. Get price, return terms and the hallmark in writing.

flags.title: No listing states a maker's mark (0 of 25)
flags.detail: FTC guidance: near the karat mark, look for the name or U.S. registered trademark of the company that stands behind it — 'If you don't see a trademark along with the karat mark, don't buy it.' Two listings claim a karat stamp ('Metal stamp: Yes'; 'Marked 14K'), but none states a maker's mark and no listing shows a photo of the stamps. Ask for a close-up photo of both marks and verify them on arrival.

flags.title: Listing does not explicitly say 'solid gold' (16 of 25)
flags.detail: A karat mark alone does not say whether an item is solid or plated/hollow. FTC guidance defines 'solid gold' as not hollow. Brilliant Earth, Blue Nile and Allurez listings name the metal and karat but do not use the words 'solid gold'; Solid Gold Jewelers shows only '14ky'. These are left unflagged as solid and require written confirmation from the seller. The 9 Etsy/Avianne/Jewelry Master listings that do say solid are recorded with their exact wording.

flags.title: Etsy return windows vary by shop — one is only 7 days
flags.detail: VeraByEden accepts returns within 7 days; ForeverForLove and Cittali state 30 days; several listings only say 'Returns & exchanges accepted' with the window in a tab that was not captured. Etsy Purchase Protection covers non-delivery, damage, late delivery and materially different items, but not buyer's remorse. Check the specific shop policy before ordering.

flags.title: Etsy prices are promo-dependent and vary by material, size and carat
flags.detail: Every Etsy listing in this set was discounted at check time (25–50% off) and prices change by material (silver/10K/14K/18K), ring size, band width and center-stone carat. The recorded price is the 14K option shown on the check date. Re-check the live price before buying.

flags.title: Gram weights are seller-stated, not independently verified
flags.detail: Allurez publishes 'approximate' gold weights; Avianne and Jewelry Master publish single figures; VeraByEden states 'Gold grams: 3.70 gr'. None of these has been independently weighed. Treat them as claims to be checked with a jeweler's scale and XRF on arrival.

flags.title: Gold spot moves all day — the snapshot is dated
flags.detail: Quotes across the 2026-10-22 and 2026-10-23 captures range from $4,022.50 to $4,086.90 per ounce (about 1.6%). This site uses one timestamped Kitco bid for every calculation and shows the timestamp. Spot at the moment you buy will differ; use the calculator with a fresh quote.

flags.title: A 14K or 18K stamp is not proof of purity
flags.detail: FTC guidance requires a karat mark plus a maker's mark, but a stamp is a disclosure, not an assay. The only way to know what the metal actually is: have an independent jeweler test it (XRF or another professional method) after delivery, before wearing or resizing. No US law requires the seller to accept a return based on your test, so confirm the return right first.

flags.title: Setting prices exclude the center diamond
flags.detail: Blue Nile and Brilliant Earth prices recorded here are 'Setting Price' / 'Setting Only'. The center stone is sold separately, so price-to-metal ratios are only computed for complete rings. Do not compare a $750 setting with a complete $1,100 ring as if they were the same purchase.

flags.title: Retailers excluded rather than guessed
flags.detail: Walmart's search results render client-side and served no product cards or prices; two listings found by search (Pompeii3 and marquise-jewelers) were dead. No values were recorded for them. Exclusion is deliberate: blank beats invented.

flags.title: Earlier sessions' work is preserved in this repo
flags.detail: Six earlier sessions delivered to this repository. Their sites remain available: 638c9614 at /docs/, 090bae73 at /index-090bae73.html (+ /pages/), 37e8ff42's dashboard at /archive/session-37e8ff42/, 93032b31's 24-row dashboard at /archive/session-93032b31/, 84be683f at /verified/, 60c4b9c3 at /report/ (evidence in /verification/), and the /guide/ checklist site. flags.title: Kitco page shows several nearby numbers in one capture
flags.detail: The 2026-10-23 capture displayed a ticker bid of $4,022.50 and $129.33/g while the body text read $4,021.00/oz and the conversion table $129.28/g; the 2026-10-22 capture similarly showed $4,026.90/$129.47 in the ticker vs $4,027.50 in the body, $129.49/g in the table, and a TradingView print of $4,028.21. references.title: FTC Consumer Advice — Buying Platinum, Gold, and Silver Jewelry
references.quote: Near the karat quality mark, look for the name or the U.S. registered trademark of the company that will stand behind the mark... If you're thinking about buying a piece of gold jewelry but don't see a trademark along with the karat mark, don't buy it.
references.usedFor: Karat marks, maker's mark rule, solid vs plated/hollow definitions, returns in writing, where to report problems.

references.title: 16 CFR Part 23 — Guides for the Jewelry, Precious Metals, and Pewter Industries
references.quote: § 23.3 Misrepresentation as to gold content. § 23.10 Additional guidance for the use of quality marks.
references.usedFor: The regulation behind the FTC consumer guidance; gold-content and quality-mark rules. eCFR displayed 'up to date as of 10/21/2026' on the 2026-10-23 fetch.

references.title: 15 U.S.C. § 295 — Standard of fineness of gold articles; deviation
references.publisher: U.S. Code (GovInfo, U.S. Government Publishing Office)
references.quote: ...the actual fineness of such gold or alloy shall not be less by more than three one-thousandth parts than the fineness indicated by the mark stamped, branded, engraved, or printed upon any part of such article... and ... shall not be less by more than seven one-thousandth parts, in the case of any other such article...
references.usedFor: The statutory assay tolerance an XRF reading is compared against: 3/1000 solder-free, 7/1000 for the whole article including solder.

references.title: 16 CFR § 23.3 — Misrepresentation as to gold content (Cornell LII mirror)
references.quote: Text of the gold-content misrepresentation rule.

references.title: 15 U.S.C. § 297 — Stamping plated articles; identifying trademark
references.quote: ...shall apply or cause to be applied to that article a trademark... in a position as close as possible to that quality mark or stamp.
references.usedFor: Statutory basis for a maker's mark next to the quality mark (National Stamping Act).

references.title: NIST SP 811, Appendix B.8 — Factors for units listed alphabetically
references.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
references.quote: Appendix B conversion factors (troy ounce). Kitco also states on its page: 'A troy ounce is 31.1034768 grams.'
references.usedFor: Troy ounce to gram conversion used by the calculator (31.1034768 g/ozt).

references.title: LBMA Precious Metal Prices — benchmark administration
references.quote: The LBMA Gold Price is set twice daily in auctions independently operated and administered by ICE Benchmark Administration Limited (IBA) and commencing at 10:30 and 15:00 London time.
references.usedFor: Why a timestamped benchmark matters; the London benchmark is set twice daily, while retail spot pages update continuously.

references.title: FTC Consumer Advice — Using Credit Cards and Disputing Charges
references.quote: Federal law says you have the right to get mistakes fixed promptly... If you have a complaint about the quality of something you bought...
references.usedFor: Why a credit card is safer than an irreversible payment method, and how billing disputes work.

references.title: Etsy Purchase Protection Program
references.quote: Full refund for eligible orders that don't arrive, arrive damaged, arrive 7+ days after the estimated delivery window, or differ significantly from the description.

references.title: Jewelers Vigilance Committee — mediation services
